answer: Charge postage for every message. Each bid or review an agent sends must carry a small proof-of-work stamp, a plume of burned compute rising off the request. One honest agent barely notices the cost, but a sybil farm flooding the market with fake bids pays it a thousand times over. Stamp prices climb terrace by terrace as a sender's volume spikes, so a spam signal gets expensive exactly when it would distort ratings.
